items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: I didn't think all that much of Bunk until I heard Russell's records

ctx.x: I didn't think all that much of Bunk until I heard Russell's records, until I got over here and heard the American music records. I thought he was just a pretty player, but they were made towards the end, when the band was kind of splitting up, I think.
